skill_name: Write an article about the impact of machine learning on society.
workflow: Machine learning has changed the face of modern society, with its capabilities advancing almost every sector of life. From healthcare, finance, and business intelligence to retail, transportation, and communication, the uses of machine learning are becoming increasingly evident. In healthcare, machine learning can be used to detect and diagnose diseases with greater accuracy and predict potential risks ahead of time.
